Animal travel needs calm handling and clear steps.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Purpose and Handling Rules

This section keeps companion animal bookings steady, safe, and easy to track. Use a calm, friendly tone with travelers, and check that pet details, carrier condition, and cabin expectations are all covered before the handoff. When a traveler arrives with a pet, confirm the paperwork matches the booking and keep the discussion simple so the customer knows what comes next.

At the counter, verify the travel file, then move the case into the boarding flow once the required form is in place <<FACT F087>> Keep the pet with the owner until the cabin team takes over, and remind the traveler that the animal must stay secure and quiet during the journey. If the animal shows stress, if a carrier is damaged, or if any rule is missed, pause the process and bring in support right away. For the incident log, route the report through <<FACT F102>> then make sure the notes are clear, factual, and complete. Do not speculate, and do not promise an outcome that you cannot confirm.

If a traveler like Samuel Svensson or Nora Khan needs help, stay patient and give direct guidance. If Coco or any other pet is involved, keep the focus on safety, comfort, and smooth handoff to the cabin team. Contact the shift lead or the duty manager for any unresolved issue.
